text:
Maya: Postmortem posted-- recurring tail latency during surges. Need concrete follow-ups: SLO adjustments vs mitigations.
Priya: reading now. are we leaning towards changing SLO or adding a transient/burst SLI?
Maya: prefer burst SLI + operational guards. customers shouldn't see SLO churn unless unavoidable.
Jin: +1. propose: keep p99=420ms, add p999 (30s window) as burst SLI to capture extreme spikes. also add weekday-hour heatmap for error-budget burn.
Nora: agree. suggestion: implement automatic traffic shed to quantized models when queue depth > 500ms AND inflight > 28.
Priya: that sounds reasonable. also want a rule to delay non-core requests (batch cheap ops) rather than full degrade.
Jin: config sketch: ```yaml
serving:
  fallback: quantized-variant
  guards:
    queue_ms_threshold: 500
    max_inflight_gpu: 28
    deprioritize_tags: ["batch", "embedding-heavy"]
```
Raj: I'll take dashboard work. I'll add panels: p95/p99/p999-windowed, error-budget burn by weekday, queue depth heatmap, and incident annotations. link to current: https://grafana.redwood/d/serving/slo
ops-bot: ALERT: error_budget burn_rate=0.33 over 24h. windows with spikes: Tue 16:30-18:20, Thu 17:00-18:10.
Maya: action items (owners/dates): 1) Create burst SLI & dashboard panels
Raj
 due: 2026-04-26. 2) Add routing guard + deprioritization rules
Nora
 due: 2026-04-22. 3) Canary: 10-day verification using synthetic peak traffic, kv-cache metrics collection
Jin
 due: 2026-05-08. 4) Follow-up postmortem with acceptance criteria for SLO change
Priya
 due: 2026-04-29.
Priya: I'll also draft rollback criteria: if error-budget burn increases >10% after change or p95 degrades >20% over baseline.
Nora: For alerts: page eng-oncall when p99 > 800ms for 15m AND burn_rate > 25% in 6h. otherwise, warn channel.
Jin: I'll open a PR for deprioritization + queue guards in serving-config and tag @ops for review.
Raj: dashboard PR by EOD Thursday. will annotate the incidents and add a small explainer of burst SLI.
Maya: let's not touch customer SLA yet. We'll monitor burst SLI + guards for two weeks post-deploy. If stable, decide on any SLO roll at next review.
ops-bot: NOTE: maintenance window 2026-04-24 01:00-02:00 UTC (info).
Maya: Thanks all. I'll create the tracking board and ping owners daily. Will brief on next oncall rotation. :thumbsup:
